applies_to: all Work-data jobs launched from this repository or any Stock project chat
startup_protocol: Verify the authoritative runtime-repository gate before beginning research.
If the authoritative gate cannot be fetched, parsed, and hash-recorded, remain on HOLD.
Restored Work-data capacity does not change readiness.
Only the committed authoritative gate may permit READY_FOR_WORK_DATA or READY_FOR_VALIDATION.
Record the authoritative commit and file SHA-256 in every resumed job artifact.
allowed_while_held: data-integrity remediation that does not consume validation evidence
